meaning:
σκήνωμα, -τος, τό
(σκηνόω), [in LXX chiefly for אֹהֶל ;]
a tent, tabernacle (cf. σκηνή, σκῆνος): of the temple as God's dwelling (Psa.132:5, al.), Act.7:46. Metaphorical, of the body: 2Pe.1:13-14.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.
I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,
